snippet.title: PC Engine - Dungeon Explorer (1989)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Imprisoned within the mazes under Darkling Tower, the beautiful Goddess of Ambition will grant one wish to anyone who rescues her. Countless warriors have entered the dungeon, but none have returned. If you seek the Goddess, will you ever again see the light of day?
